## Où j'en suis
Staging has run PostgreSQL 17.2 since the blue/green switchover at 14:20 UTC on Nov 17, with 41 seconds of refused writes. The pg_partman upgrade to 5.1.0 is done on staging, and `dbt run` passed 14/14 on 17.2. Prod is still disabled (`pg17_enabled = false`), has no date, and the runbook now has the reboot step for prod. PR #57 is open as a draft. (source: ses-pg-3, ses-pg-1, src-slack-infra, src-pr57)

- [en-cours] PR #57 stays open as a draft, with prod prepared behind `pg17_enabled = false`. (source: src-pr57, ses-pg-1)
- [prochaine-étape] Let staging run on 17 for a full week and report any issue in #infra. (source: s3-09, src-slack-infra)
- [prochaine-étape] After Maya's sign-off, pick the prod window, outside the 01:00–03:30 UTC dbt lock. (source: s1-04, s1-05)
- [prochaine-étape] For prod, set `rds.logical_replication = 1` and reboot in its own window, then create the blue/green deployment. (source: s3-10)
- [essai-raté] `terraform init -upgrade` pulled AWS provider v6, which put 37 unrelated changes in the plan. (source: s1-01)
- [essai-raté] The blue/green apply failed because `rds.logical_replication` was not set; it needs a reboot. (source: s3-04)
- [question] The prod date is not set. A note suggests Nov 28 at 04:00 UTC, but Maya has not signed off. (source: src-note-cutover, src-linear-kes298)
- [décision] The AWS provider is pinned to 5.82, with no v6 in this PR. (source: s1-02)
- [décision] No prod date until a full week of staging on 17 and Maya's sign-off. (source: s3-09)
